issues.description: Method mismatch for Lecture.addGuestStudents: the template repository declares a public method with signature addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, boolean validateInput) (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 19), while the problem statement and the solution repository specify a single-parameter method addGuestStudents(int) (problem_statement.md lines 49-51; solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 90). This parameter-list difference (extra boolean in the template) creates a conflicting public API that will confuse students about the required method signature and may cause automated checks or example code that call addGuestStudents(int) to not match the template's provided stub.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem statement and solution by changing the template method signature to: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents). If input validation is desired, implement it inside that method or add a private helper overload rather than exposing an extra boolean parameter in the public API. Update the template method stub accordingly so students implement the expected signature.
